review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; identity visible; original scientific-quality rubric

errors.quote: a phasic response to unpredicted reward
errors.issue: Including reward responsiveness in dopamine identity selects a response-defined subset and does not establish chemical identity. Use independent validated identity criteria or label the population putative and restricted; do not imply coverage of all dopamine neurons.

errors.quote: If only the late window is modulated, report M4, not uncertainty.
errors.issue: Late or ramping anticipatory uncertainty is not excluded by being near outcome. Timing shape alone cannot select hazard over uncertainty; the target itself includes gradually increasing delay activity. Test probability-by-time and timing manipulations rather than discard this target pattern.
Three nondegenerate levels can identify linear and quadratic terms. Five levels improve shape and paired contrasts but are not mathematically necessary to avoid collinearity.

Constraining outcome runs can make conditional probability depend on history. Validate the scheduling hazard and use the actual conditional probability in learning models; adding only recent reward rate may not suffice.

errors.quote: Delay activity must not predict the sampled outcome within a probability.
errors.issue: A pre-outcome difference can reflect learned schedule/history rather than sensory leakage. Outcome splits are a diagnostic, not proof of illicit prediction or a reason to select only favorable trials.

errors.quote: only if a monotonic delay effect needs to be separated
errors.issue: Matched-value/magnitude tests are useful for nonlinear interpretations too. A quadratic fixed-magnitude effect separates selected linear models but cannot exclude all nonlinear value or salience explanations.

errors.quote: Primary biological unit: neuron nested in animal.
errors.issue: Animals are the independent biological replication level for a population-general claim; neurons are nested observations. The hierarchical model partly addresses this wording, but power must explicitly represent independent animals and between-animal variation.

No actual species/region, chemically validated population, recording platform or working task parameters beyond an illustrative delay are selected. The minimum transient-relative effect also needs a scientific rationale rather than an arbitrary fraction.

rationale: Recognizes the probability/uncertainty direction and proposes useful synchronized behavior, held-out analysis and calibration. Response-based identity and a rule rejecting late uncertainty signals critically compromise the target readout and prediction; no qualified hit.
reference_guardrails: All three complete final answers personally read against full question/reference/target; truncated Grok tail and Qwen middle sections separately read. Original rubric only; strict round inactive.

Historical qualification follows explicit reference core: uncertainty versus value, probability manipulation, separated phasic/delay readouts, intermediate-versus-endpoint prediction. Matched-value/magnitude challenges improve scientific identification; their incomplete implementation limits quality without silently becoming an extra binary gate.

Ramping or late pre-outcome activity can be an uncertainty correlate. Its timing alone cannot select hazard. Assess joint probability-by-time models and timing controls; never reject the historical direction solely because its signal grows near outcome.

Physiological dopamine identity is putative unless independently validated; selecting cells for event responses biases the sampled population. A preparation-level assay check is distinct from per-neuron response selection.

Fixed-magnitude inverted-U activity distinguishes certain prespecified linear/value models, not every nonlinear value, salience, temporal or movement model. Correlated covariate adjustment and held-out decoding do not alone identify cause.

Probability probes and run-limited schedules alter experienced contingencies. Preserve actual conditional probabilities, history and all valid anticipatory trials; future-outcome splits are diagnostics, not grounds for outcome-based neural selection.

The primary paper itself documents incomplete intermediate-probability coverage in a subset of cells. This is a limitation to disclose, not proof of fabrication or a reason to copy the sampling bias. Reference guardrails remain modern proposed controls, not claims that the historical study implemented them.
